title: Proteogenomics connects somatic mutations to signalling in breast cancer
cohort: 105 TCGA breast tumors analyzed; 77 high-quality tumors emphasized for integrated analysis
method: iTRAQ 4-plex; global proteome plus phosphopeptide enrichment
instrument: not explicit in extracted main PDF text
evidence: Main PDF text: 15,369 proteins and 62,679 phosphosites identified; 12,553 proteins and 33,239 phosphosites quantified after filtering.
notes: Acetylome was not part of the reported CPTAC breast proteogenomic dataset in the extracted PDF text.

title: Proteogenomic Characterization of Endometrial Carcinoma
method: TMT-10; bRPLC fractionation; IMAC phosphopeptide enrichment; acetyl-lysine enrichment
instrument: nanoACQUITY UPLC coupled to Orbitrap Fusion Lumos
evidence: STAR Methods: 12,153 proteins, 73,212 phosphosites, and 10,862 lysine acetylation sites across all tumors.
notes: Average per tumor was also reported: 10,088 proteins, 29,710 phosphosites, and 3,821 acetylation sites.

title: Proteogenomic Characterization Reveals Therapeutic Vulnerabilities in Lung Adenocarcinoma
cohort: 110 tumors and 101 matched normal adjacent tissues
protein_count_type: filtered protein features used for tumor-NAT PCA
method: TMT-10; global proteome, IMAC phosphoproteome, acetylproteome; Spectrum Mill processing
instrument: Q Exactive HF-X for proteome; Orbitrap Fusion Lumos for phosphoproteome and acetylproteome
evidence: STAR Methods: VM-site polishing yielded 65,103 phosphosites and 13,480 acetylsites; tumor-NAT PCA used 10,165 proteins, 40,845 phosphosites, and 6,984 acetylsites.
notes: Protein count is the filtered analysis feature count visible in extracted text, not necessarily the total raw protein identification count.

title: Proteogenomic insights into HPV-negative head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
cohort: 108 tumors; paired NAT subset used for tumor-normal comparisons
method: TMT-11; bRPLC fractionation; Fe-IMAC phosphopeptide enrichment; global proteome and phosphoproteome
instrument: Easy nLC 1200 UHPLC coupled to Thermo Fusion Lumos
evidence: Results text: 11,744 proteins; 97,210 phosphopeptides covering 56,959 confidently localized phosphosites from 8,133 genes.
notes: No acetylome layer was described in the extracted paper text.

title: Proteogenomic characterization of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
cohort: 140 pancreatic cancer cases; 67 NATs and 8 normal ductal tissues in MS workflow
method: TMT-11; bRPLC; Fe-IMAC phosphopeptide enrichment; glycopeptide enrichment
instrument: Easy nLC 1200 UHPLC coupled to Orbitrap Fusion Lumos
evidence: Results text: proteomics, phosphoproteomics, and glycoproteomics identified and quantified 11,662 proteins, 51,469 phosphosites, and 34,024 glycopeptides.
notes: This study used glycoproteomics rather than acetylomics.

title: A proteogenomic portrait of lung squamous cell carcinoma
protein_count_type: not explicit in extracted main PDF text
method: TMT-11; serial proteome/phosphoproteome/acetylproteome workflow; K-GG ubiquitylproteome subset
instrument: Q Exactive HF-X for proteome/acetylproteome; Orbitrap Fusion Lumos for phosphoproteome/ubiquitylproteome
evidence: STAR Methods: VM-site polishing yielded 68,674 phosphosites, 15,186 acetylsites, and 25,489 ubiquitylsites.
notes: Figure S1B contains per-plex quantified protein bars, but the extracted PDF text did not expose a single global protein count.

title: Proteogenomic characterization of 2002 human cancers reveals pan-cancer molecular subtypes and associated pathways
cohort: 2002 primary tumors across 14 cancer types and 17 studies
protein_count_type: unique genes represented by total-protein compendium
method: Integrated processed LC-MS/MS proteomic and phosphoproteomic datasets from CPTAC/public studies
evidence: Methods: total proteins covered 15,439 unique genes; phosphoprotein compendium contained 199,284 phospho-protein features involving 11,671 genes.
notes: This is a cross-study compendium rather than a single newly acquired MS experiment.

title: Pan-cancer proteogenomics connects oncogenic drivers to functional states
cohort: 1064 participants across seven CPTAC tumor types
acetyl_count_type: not part of reported cross-cancer feature set
method: Integrated CPTAC mass-spectrometry proteomic and phosphoproteomic data
instrument: varied by contributing CPTAC source study
evidence: Intro/results text: mass-spectrometry-based proteomic and phosphoproteomic data expanded quantified features to 15,699 proteins and 110,274 phosphosites.
notes: Acetylome was not included in the extracted pan-cancer feature-count statement.

title: Phosphoproteomic and Acetylomic Characterization of Colorectal Cancer Cells Treated with Kinase Inhibitors
cohort: HCT116 cells treated with seven kinase inhibitors plus DMSO; two replicates per inhibitor
method: TMTpro 16-plex; TiO2 phosphopeptide enrichment; acetylated peptide enrichment; MaxQuant
evidence: Results text: 6,147 proteins; 6,213 phosphorylated sites including 5,048 class I sites and 2,552 proteins; 185 acetylated sites corresponding to 135 proteins.
notes: Included as a recent perturbational PTM multi-omics study, not as a patient tumor cohort.
